arxiv-2211-01286.title: Novel results obtained by modeling of dynamic processes in superconductors: phase-slip centers as cooling engines
arxiv-2211-01286.creator: Iris Mowgood, Serafim Teknowijoyo, Sara Chahid, Armen Gulian
arxiv-2211-01286.description: Abstract Based on a time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau system of equations and finite element modeling, we present novel results related with the physics of phase-slippage in superconducting wires surrounded by a non-superconductive environment. These results are obtained within our previously reported approach related to superconducting rings and superconductive gravitational wave detector transducers.

arxiv-2304-13062.title: Enhanced Extreme Mass Ratio Inspiral Rates into Intermediate Mass Black Holes
arxiv-2304-13062.creator: Ismail Qunbar, Nicholas C. Stone
arxiv-2304-13062.description: Abstract Extreme mass ratio inspirals (EMRIs) occur when stellar-mass compact objects begin a gravitational wave (GW) driven inspiral into massive black holes. EMRI waveforms can precisely map the surrounding spacetime, making them a key target for future space-based GW interferometers such as LISA , but their event rates and parameters are massively uncertain.

arxiv-2307-15636.title: Wells type exact sequence and crossed extensions of algebras with bracket
arxiv-2307-15636.creator: José Manuel Casas 1, Emzar Khmaladze 2, Manuel Ladra 3
arxiv-2307-15636.description: Abstract . We study the extensibility problem of a pair of derivations associated with an abelian extension of algebras with bracket, and derive an exact sequence of the Wells type. We introduce crossed modules for algebras with bracket and prove their equivalence with internal categories in the category of algebras with bracket.

arxiv-2411-09402.title: Automated Segmentation of Ischemic Stroke Lesions in Non-Contrast Computed Tomography Images for Enhanced Treatment and Prognosis
arxiv-2411-09402.creator: Toufiq Musah, Prince Ebenezer Adjei, Kojo Obed Otoo
arxiv-2411-09402.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Toufiq Musah, Prince Ebenezer Adjei, Kojo Obed Otoo. Stroke is the second leading cause of death worldwide, and is increasingly prevalent in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). Timely interventions can significantly influence stroke survivability and the quality of life after treatment. However, the standard and most widely available imaging method for confirming strokes and their sub-types, the NCCT, is more challenging and time-consuming to employ in cases of ischemic stroke.

arxiv-2507-06058.creator: Marius Cizauskas, Elisa M. Sala, Jon Heffernan, A. Mark Fox, Manfred Bayer, Alex Greilich
arxiv-2507-06058.description: Abstract We investigate the spin properties of InAs/InGaAs/InP quantum dots grown by metalorganic vapor-phase epitaxy (MOVPE) deposition using droplet epitaxy, which emit in the telecom C-band. Using pump-probe Faraday ellipticity measurements, we determine electron and hole g g -factors of | g e | = 0.934 |g_{e}|=0.934 and | g h | = 0.471 |g_{h}|=0.

arxiv-2509-02423.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Justyna Jaworska, Bartłomiej Kielak, Tomáš Masařík, Jana Masaříková. The k k - Coloring problem on hereditary graph classes has been a deeply researched problem over the last decade. A hereditary graph class is characterized by a (possibly infinite) list of minimal forbidden induced subgraphs. We say that a graph is ( H 1 , H 2 , … ) (H_{1},H_{2},\ldots) -free if it does not contain any of H 1 , H 2 , … H_{1},H_{2},\ldots as induced subgraphs.

arxiv-2510-06339.title: Vi-TacMan: Articulated Object Manipulation via Vision and Touch
arxiv-2510-06339.creator: Leiyao Cui, Zihang Zhao, Sirui Xie, Wenhuan Zhang, Zhi Han, Yixin Zhu, https://vi-tacman.github.io
arxiv-2510-06339.description: Abstract Autonomous manipulation of articulated objects remains a fundamental challenge for robots in human environments. Vision-based methods can infer hidden kinematics but can yield imprecise estimates on unfamiliar objects. Tactile approaches achieve robust control through contact feedback but require accurate initialization. This suggests a natural synergy: vision for global guidance, touch for local precision.

pmc-10496350.title: COLLAGENE enables privacy-aware federated and collaborative genomic data analysis
pmc-10496350.creator: Wentao Li, Miran Kim, Kai Zhang, Han Chen, Xiaoqian Jiang, Arif Harmanci
pmc-10496350.description: Growing regulatory requirements set barriers around genetic data sharing and collaborations. Moreover, existing privacy-aware paradigms are challenging to deploy in collaborative settings. We present COLLAGENE, a tool base for building secure collaborative genomic data analysis methods. COLLAGENE protects data using shared-key homomorphic encryption and combines encryption with multiparty strategies for efficient privacy-aware collaborative method development.

pmc-10606519.title: Impacts of Complete Unemployment Rates Disaggregated by Reason and Duration on Suicide Mortality from 2009–2022 in Japan
pmc-10606519.creator: Ryusuke Matsumoto, Eishi Motomura, Motohiro Okada, Chung-Yi Li
pmc-10606519.description: In Japan, suicides had consistently decreased before the COVID-19 pandemic (from 2009–2019), but conversely increased after the pandemic outbreak (from 2020–2022). To identify the features of fluctuations of suicides in Japan, the standardized suicide mortality rates per 100,000 population (SMRP) disaggregated by gender (males/females) and age (10-year cohorts) from 2009–2022 were analyzed using interrupted time-series and joinpoint regression analyses.

pmc-11428651.title: Effect of Presence of Uni- or Bilateral Thyroid Adenoma on Recovery of Pituitary–Thyroid Axis and Creatinine Concentration in Radioiodine-Treated Cats
pmc-11428651.creator: Anna Paulina Menzel, Joanna Lin, Arne Güssow, Ve Patzelt, Natali Bauer, Katarina Hazuchova
pmc-11428651.description: Simple SummaryHyperthyroidism is the most common endocrinopathy in older cats and radioiodine therapy (RAIT) is the gold standard for its treatment. Nevertheless, information about changes in thyroid and kidney values after RAIT over a period longer than six months and the effect of the presence of uni- or bilateral thyroid adenoma on these values is scarce or unreported.

pmc-13179362.title: Metabolic vulnerabilities and therapeutic opportunities in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
pmc-13179362.creator: Marie Anne-Catherine Neumann, Christian Frezza
pmc-13179362.description: Diffuse large B cell lymphoma (DLBCL), the most common type of non-Hodgkin lymphoma (NHL), exhibits considerable biological heterogeneity. While its classification has traditionally relied on genetic and transcriptomic features, emerging evidence points to distinct metabolic subtypes that may represent novel therapeutic vulnerabilities.
